verdict.rationale: The enterprise-readiness docs list deployment and data-residency options, including regional endpoints, single-tenant, BYOC and self-hosting. The self-hosting docs describe running the full LlamaCloud platform on Kubernetes in your own AWS, Azure or GCP infrastructure, which keeps data under your control and in a location you choose. Missing for 10: the specific regions offered, documentation of how to select a region on the managed SaaS (or whether it is Enterprise-only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
